body.condition: There exists a compact set \(\mathcal X\subset\mathbb R^p\) containing \(\operatorname{supp}\nu\) and every \(x_{in}\) such that, for each \(q\in\mathcal Q\), the conditional first and second moments and all of their \(\rho\)-derivatives through order three are continuous and uniformly bounded on \(\mathcal X\times\mathcal K\).
